description: Add 1–500 flashcards to a deck in one call, or update existing ones. mode "add" (default) skips exact duplicates (same front AND back, ignoring case and spacing), so re-sending a list is safe; mode "update" overwrites the answer of cards whose front already exists, keeping their review progress. Returns created/updated/unchanged/skipped counts. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

cards.description: Cards to add or update (1–500 per call).

back.description: Answer side — e.g. the translation or answer.

front.description: Prompt side — e.g. a word in the language being learned, or a question.

hint.description: Optional clue shown before the answer is revealed.

deck_id.description: Deck to add to — from list_memo_decks or create_memo_deck.

mode.description: add (default): add only cards that are not in the deck yet — a duplicate is the same front AND back (ignoring case/spacing), so re-sending a list is safe. update: cards whose front already exists get their back (and hint/tags, when you pass them) overwritten, keeping their review progress; new fronts are added. Replacing a whole deck is intentionally not available over MCP.

name: add_memo_cards
